provenance: SYNTHETIC, AI-JUDGED, NOT INDEPENDENT: twelve simulated author profiles write the v2 sentences (train R1-R6, dev D1-D3, test E1-E3, no profile or scenario group shared between splits); labels are the author's intent, checked by two configurations of one local AI judge and settled by the builder where both judges disagreed with the intent; no person wrote, labelled or reviewed any row. Training also uses the old template set and the v1 synthetic set (already scored, never v2 dev or test). A generalisation check, not evidence about real trainee speech. Hard negatives: the 179 evasive critical sentences of the three tuning adversarial sets are added to training with their critical act (build_safe_heads.py).
note: Credit needs the act to be neither NONE nor critical and its probability to reach the threshold; critical acts are recorded, never credited from speech. Deterministic action-based scoring stays authoritative.
